description: Load a shared session as a handoff: summary, decisions, next steps, files and conversation. mode "tail" (default) = summary + recent messages; "summary" = summary only; "full" = full transcript, paged with offset.

id.description: Session id from list_sessions or search_sessions

offset.description: With mode "full": message to start from, for paging

tail.description: With mode "tail": only this many of the most recent messages (default: all that were shared)

name: get_session
title: Load a shared session
